subject: general
question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

The (departure) of people from the city isn't necessarily good news.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e. **'exodus'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Departure:** (प्रस्थान) The act of leaving or going away from a place or situation.

 
 
• **Example:** The ***departure ***of the train was delayed by half an hour.
 
 
 
• **Exodus**: (निर्गमन) A mass departure or migration of people, especially when leaving a place in large numbers.
 
 
• **Example: **The ***exodus ***of workers from the city in search of better opportunities was significant.
 
 
 
• From the above example it is clear that **'Exodus' ** is similar to **'Departure'.**

*Therefore, the correct answer is **'exodus'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Abidance: **(पालन) The act of following a rule, law, or standard.

 
 
• **Example: **Her ***abidance ***by the company's policies made her a reliable employee.
 
 
 
• **Continuation: **(जारी रखना) The act of carrying on or extending something without interruption.
 
 
• **Example:** The ***continuation ***of the project is essential to meet the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Excavation:** (खदान) The process of digging or removing earth, soil, or material from a site, often for archaeological or construction purposes.
 
 
• **Example: **Two archaeologists, Dayaram Sahni and R.D. Banerjee led the ***excavations ***at Harappa and Mohenjo-daro respectively.
